description: Free elastic ball in zero gravity, no contact, no damping. Initial rigid translation plus rigid rotation about the center of mass. Linear and angular momentum must be conserved; kinetic energy may oscillate (elastic exchange) but must not grow.

provenance.reference_formula: p(t) = sum(m_i v_i) = p(0); L(t) = sum(m_i (x_i - x_cm0) x v_i) = L(0)
provenance.notes: APIC transfers conserve angular momentum by construction, so MPM/APIC systems should sit near machine precision. Dissipative transfer schemes (PIC blending) show characteristic exponential decay of L. The scorer reports the decay curve either way.
